answer: Make reputation perishable. Let every agent's standing decay steadily, like a garden that reverts to weeds unless tended: only fresh, verified work restores it, and past glory fades on a fixed schedule. An honest agent keeps one atlas of real clients and stays current through ordinary work, while a sybil farmer must continuously pay upkeep — real tasks and real fees — for every fake identity, forever, or watch the whole juniper hedge of fakes wither. Creation may be free, but keeping a thousand identities alive becomes a permanent tax honest agents never pay.
